summary: Tested LOTR 5e Treasure System new features: name generator, manufacture multipliers, price calculation, and quality descriptions. All core features working correctly except quality descriptions are not displayed in the UI.

issues: Quality descriptions (descripcion field) are defined in WEAPON_QUALITIES, ARMOR_QUALITIES, and SHIELD_QUALITIES arrays but NOT displayed in the UI when selecting qualities. Only quality name and multiplier badge are shown.

action_items: Consider adding quality descriptions to UI - either as tooltips on hover, inline text below quality name, or in a details panel when quality is selected
critical_code_review_comments: WEAPON_QUALITIES array (line 145-188) has descripcion field but it's never rendered in quality selection UI
Same issue for ARMOR_QUALITIES (line 191-204) and SHIELD_QUALITIES (line 207-218)
Price calculation formula is correctly implemented: base × manufacture × quality_multipliers + perdition_costs

success_rate.frontend: 95% - All core features pass, descriptions enhancement suggested

context_for_next_testing_agent: Treasure System 'Armas Famosas' tab fully functional. Name generator uses culture-specific prefix/root/suffix patterns. Manufacture multipliers: numenorean=5, elven_eregion=4, elven_beleriand=6, dwarven_khazad=3, dwarven_erebor=3, dwarven_beleriand=4. Price formula: base × manufacture × qualities + perditions. All calculations verified correct. Quality descriptions exist in code but not rendered in UI.

name_generator.details: Wand icon button generates culture-specific names. Tested: Númenóreana->Talangos, Élfica Eregion->Mithlómor, Enana Erebor->Balgromdun

manufacture_selector_multipliers.details: All 6 manufactures show correct multipliers in dropdown: Númenóreana(×5), Élfica Eregion(×4), Élfica Beleriand(×6), Khazad-dûm(×3), Erebor(×3), Nogrod/Belegost(×4)

quality_descriptions.details: Descriptions defined in WEAPON_QUALITIES/ARMOR_QUALITIES/SHIELD_QUALITIES arrays but not rendered in UI. Only quality name and multiplier badge shown.
